Current milestone state — updated 2026-07-23 (v1.3.0 SHIPPED + verified).

VERSION: v1.3.0 SHIPPED stable 2026-07-23 (tag 1638f35, release run 30017954027 headSha-verified, published non-draft, 4 binaries, Homebrew formula bumped to 1.3.0). Prior: v1.2.2. Channels: rvr stable 1.3.0, rvr-beta (1.0.0-beta.3), rvr-dev.

v1.3.0 'TRUST THE RECORD' CONTENTS: #130 test-traffic tagging/exclusion, #133 import replace-all unification, #134 selfRef observability (op:'meta' fires), #141 canonical projectId, #142 bulk-write segmentation, #135 audit --follow --json NDJSON watcher stream + --exclude-session, #138 ambient agent detection. CI: #131 Leg A automation (Dependabot/bun-audit cron/CodeQL/SECURITY.md + repo settings), #132 perf cron w/ STRESS_MEAN_MS.

SECURITY (Leg B, 3 rounds — the release's main story): R1 → 2 medium (#158 confirm-bypass-via-interpolation, #159 symlink store escape); R2 → 2 high (gaps in R1 fixes: resolveRef dropped noExec on ${value}→$(exec) chains; atomicWrite predictable-tmp symlink write-side → RCE); R3 CLEAN (all 4 surface auditors empty). Fixed in PR #160 (merged 1638f35). Regression tests encode every exploit (marker-based for confirm). Leg C smoke on PUBLISHED binary: exec-on-read (GHSA-hf25) held, #158 ${key} + ${value}→$(exec) gates held, --yes positive works, #159 symlink .reverie refused + real-store control passed, --version=1.3.0. 1516 tests.

OPEN FOLLOW-UP (decide next session): file GHSAs for #158/#159? The v1.2.1 RCE got GHSA-hf25 (see [[context.ghsaExecOnRead]]) — both new findings are hostile-store class, high severity, in a shipped release (1.2.x line). Precedent + scoping (general advisory, ecosystem 'other', NOT npm) in context.ghsaExecOnRead. Likely YES for both. Also: were 1.2.x users exposed? #158 confirm-bypass and #159 symlink existed pre-1.3.0 — the advisory should note affected range.

SOAK: CLOCK STARTS 2026-07-23 (v1.3.0 changed agent-facing behavior). Per rewritten [[project.soakPolicy]] exit gate (transport-agnostic: ≥150 calls, ≥5 active days, ≥5 namespaces, ≥3 projects, ≥7 days; agent-diversity soft signal). Day-7 checkpoint 2026-07-30, re-check day-10, hard cap 2026-08-06. This is the FIRST soak eval on a clean record (test traffic now excluded) and against the new gate — refine calibration from it.

CARRIED CANDIDATES for next theme (v1.4.0 Find is the planned next minor, but a Trust-2 could pull these): #137 session derivation, #136 retrospective, #139 audit value controls, #140 miss-path surfacing, #84 entry health, #42 git-freshness, #45 attribution. Cross-machine dataset findings: [[context.crossMachineDataset]] (work-machine copy DELETED by user 2026-07-23 — the employer-confidential exposure is resolved).

RELEASE MAP: v1.4.0 Find (#13 #43 #47) / v1.5.0 Reach (#50 #6 #49) / v1.6.0 Share (#115) / v1.7.0 Scale (#44 #48 #143) / v1.8.0 Surfaces (#51) / v2.0.0 (#128, Sept 2027).

TIER-3 REFACTOR BACKLOG: full import-pipeline unification (computeImportSections seeded it), rename/copy core, paths.ts walk dedup, registerTool migration (22 deprecations), load() snapshot memo.

NON-ENGINEERING: commercial GTM ([[project.commercialContext]]), launch comms, visual identity. This 3-round-audit release cycle is strong dogfooding case-study material (the gate caught a bug in its own fix).
